# layout-sticky
tap id:case-layout-sticky
expect Sticky bar
# In the flow: its insets say where it sticks, not where it is laid out.
frame id:sticky-bar 0 100 390 40
frame id:sticky-heading 0 0 390 30
# `top: 16`: from 84 (its 100 less 16)
# until its end meets the end of the content (1140).
prop scroll:text:"Sticky bar" stickyHeaderIndices start=84 end=1084
# The heading sticks within its section (50 to 450).
prop scroll:text:"Sticky heading" stickyHeaderIndices start=50 end=420
# An animated `top`: the platform adds its value as it pins, every frame,
# so the travel is the one at the top: from 60 until its end meets the
# content's (690).
frame id:sticky-animated 0 60 390 30
prop scroll:text:"Sticky animated" stickyHeaderIndices start=60 end=660
